name: Clean
long_description:
Agents can run outreach on their own now.

In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone.

Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal.

We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.
one_liner: Revenue intelligence for agents and sales teams.
